name: a-stash-pop-that-conflicts-keeps-the-stash

steps.stdout: Saved working directory and index state stash@{0}: base

steps.stderr: ws-git: Merge landed with conflict markers in 1 file(s): fix them and commit (ws-git status shows them as UU). The stash is kept as stash@{0}: drop it (ws-git stash drop) once you are done with it.
steps.stdout:
CONFLICT (content): Merge conflict in a.txt
[main <c3>] merge main.stash-0 (1 file)

steps.stderr: ws-git: an unresolved merge from main.stash-0 is outstanding: 1 path(s) still carry conflict markers, and nothing else moves this tree until they are gone. Fix them and commit (ws-git commit -m ...), or drop the merge (ws-git merge --abort), then stash.

summary: A pop is a merge: a conflicted one lands with markers and keeps the stash, and a stash is refused over an outstanding merge.
